317-1475-2511.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional modified creature with power 1 or greater.
317-1475-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another modified creature with power one or greater.
When the creature dies, Mazirek and One with the Kami triggers.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Resolve the Mazirek trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat.

2105-5778-6791-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

3525-4289-7938.description:
Activate Shuttle Ace by tapping it, adding {U}.
Shuttle Ace triggers, causing you to gain 2 life
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Shuttle Ace.
Repeat.

225-1479-5700-5701-7889.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
225-1479-5700-5701-7889.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

4-1170-7516.easyPrerequisites: Have a Bite must have valid targets.
4-1170-7516.description:
Cast Have a Bite using the convoke ability from Hoarding Broodlord by tapping Adventurous Eater.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Adventurous Eater, which enters prepared.
Resolve Have a Bite.
Repeat.

431-2557-4772-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-2557-4772-7824.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

1987-3075-5913.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-3075-5913.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters
1987-3075-5913.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Pinnacle Monk
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3075-5913.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7607.easyPrerequisites: There are at least one land card in all graveyards
2511-6972-7607.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Centaur Vinecrasher.
When Centaur Vinecrasher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1409-4067-7432.easyPrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1409-4067-7432.description:
Activate Orysa by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Orysa enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Orysa.
Resolve the Orysa trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Activate the permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

2086-4050-6996.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Repeat.

1806-2060-2445-4050-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Branching Evolution.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2646-4050-4559-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2646-4050-4559-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4689-6791.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4689-6791.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Otharri as attackers.
Otharri triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-2533-4681-6913.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Chameleon enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1308-1409-5419.description:
Activate Kalain by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kalain enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kalain.
Resolve the Kalain trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

147-1532-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1532-5686.description:
Cast Faith's Reward by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Faith's Reward.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Faith's Reward
Resolve the Faith's Reward copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

372-1031-2072.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Scrollshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1031-2072.description:
Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian and causing you to draw a card.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Invasion of Arcavios and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Invasion of Arcavios trigger.
Resolve the Invasion of Arcavios trigger, returning Scrollshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Scrollshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Invasion of Arcavios and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

394-856-2921-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1617-3130-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
1617-3130-4831-4983-5358.description:
Cast Blue Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and the nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur each trigger twice.
Resolve all Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having the token and nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur fight Cacophodon.
1617-3130-4831-4983-5358.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters, you may instead have Cacophodon fight another creature you control.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

5551-5552-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
5551-5552-5686.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat from step 4.

2082-3192-4050.notablePrerequisites: Ulasht has at least one removable +1/+1 counter on it.
2082-3192-4050.description:
Activate Ulasht by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
When the Saproling dies, Sadistic Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ulasht.
Repeat.

3391-4871-5231-5752.description:
Activate Korozda Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{B}{G} and sacrificing Brokkos.
When Brokkos dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Korozda Guildmage ability, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {R}.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 4 three additional times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U/B}{B}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Brokkos from your graveyard for its mutate ability by paying {2}{U/B}{G}{G}, putting it on top of a Saproling token.
Repeat.

2440-3490-5508.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2440-3490-5508.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on any creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes and Railway Brawler trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Servo you control.
Resolve the Railway Brawler trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Servo.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

967-1678-4166-5078.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure token.
967-1678-4166-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Mayhem Devil triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Ob Nixilis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, and exiling Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library with the ability to cast it from exile until your end step.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

467-1379-1978-4659-4893.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause Shorikai to become a creature this turn.
Shorikai does not have summoning sickness.
467-1379-1978-4659-4893.description:
Cause Shorikai to become a creature.
Activate Shorikai by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards, discard a card, and create a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Pilot, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {1}, untapping Shorikai.
Repeat.

990-3433-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
990-3433-4050.description:
Activate Recurring Nightmare by sacrificing a creature and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, returning Hornet Queen from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hornet Queen enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Hornet Queen and two Insects, adding {2}{B}.
Cast Recurring Nightmare by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

1020-1117-4647-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken artifact with mana value one or less that can be cast using only colorless mana.
1020-1117-4647-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the nontoken artifact with mana value one or less and Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, its ability triggers twice, returning Junk Diver and the nontoken artifact with mana one or less to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Junk Diver and the nontoken artifact by paying at most {4}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the nontoken artifact and Junk Diver, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers twice, returning the nontoken artifact and Myr Retriever to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast the nontoken artifact and Myr Retriever by paying at most {3}.
Repeat.

1350-4423-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Time Warp on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Mystic Sanctuary from the battlefield to your hand.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

851-1392-2034-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Goblin.
851-1392-2034-4871.description:
Activate Weirding Shaman by paying {3}{B} and sacrificing a Goblin.
The Goblin dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Weirding Shaman ability, creating four 1/1 Goblin Rogue creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Goblin Rogue creature token, adding {C}{C}.
The Goblin Rogue dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1961-2793-4450-5089.description:
Activate Throne of Geth by tapping it and sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Throne of Geth ability, putting a loyalty counter on Karn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

1778-2459-3156-4763.description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Rograkh, targeting Memnite.
Rograkh dies, triggering Koll, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Memnite.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Memnite, targeting Rograkh.
Memnite dies, triggering Koll, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Rograkh.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1486-1651-3215.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Bloodline Pretender and another artifact, targeting Bloodline Pretender.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Bloodline Pretender.
Repeat.

uses.n: Growing Rites of Itlimoc // Itlimoc, Cradle of the Sun

192-4915.notablePrerequisites:
Cradle of the Sun.
You control at least six creatures.
192-4915.description:
Activate Itlimoc by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Wakeroot Elemental by paying {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}, untapping Itlimoc and causing it to become a 5/5 Elemental creature with haste until end of turn that is still a land.
Repeat.

2103-2493-3395.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Archaeomancer by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Capture of Jingzhou to your hand.
Activate Crystal Shard by paying {U} and tapping it, returning Archaeomancer to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
